title: Geometric set stalks and germs of algebraic spaces
statement: Work in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $X$ an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space]. For an $S$-scheme $P$ and a map $x:h_P\to X$, use the pointed etale neighbourhood category $N_X(x)$ and its forgetful functor to $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ from [def-sfb-space-pointed-etale-abelian-stalk]. For sheaves of sets valued in $\operatorname{Type}(\max(u+1,w))$, define the functor $F\mapsto F_x=\operatorname{colim}_{N_X(x)^{op}} F(U)$, acting on sheaf morphisms by the induced colimit map. For every pointed chart $(U,\widetilde x)$ define the germ $F(U)\to F_x$ as the corresponding colimit cocone map. When $P=\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$ with $\Omega$ algebraically closed, this is the geometric set stalk and its germ.
